name: Mark of Honor
label: Quest
description: Mark of Honor: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have proven your value to our efforts in Warsong Gulch. Continue to rage against the Silverwing Sentinels! Bring me more marks of honor!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The night elves and their allies must tremble at even the whisper of your name! For the Horde!
